assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: transparent horizontal logo and wordmark for the LightDubber GitHub README.
Primary request: a compact LD monogram in forest green and mint. The L and D form one continuous rounded mark; a short waveform sits in the D negative space to suggest lightweight video dubbing. Use a forest-green-to-mint gradient for both the symbol and the wordmark. Pair it with the exact wordmark "LightDubber" in a refined geometric sans-serif. Keep strong legibility at small sizes.
Style: clean flat vector-like raster, soft corners, optical kerning, no shadow or mockup.
Color palette: forest green #234c41, dark ink #162c2f, mint #c4e8d6.
Composition: wide transparent horizontal lockup with compact spacing. No slogan, watermark, checkerboard, or other text.
assets.edit_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent LightDubber logo for a GitHub README.
Input image is the exact edit target. Change ONLY the color fill of the "LightDubber" wordmark on the right: replace its almost-solid dark green with a clear, smooth horizontal green gradient, from forest/emerald green #287653 at the left of the word, through jade green #3f9d79 in the middle, to mint green #76c4a1 at the far right. It must visually match the green-to-mint gradient of the LD symbol. Keep the existing symbol EXACTLY as it is, and preserve the text spelling, letter shapes, size, kerning, baseline, position, all transparent areas, image aspect ratio and clean vector-like appearance. Text remains precisely "LightDubber" once. No background, glow, outline, shadow, extra text or new objects. Genuine transparent alpha.

Use case: compositing.
Asset type: LightDubber GitHub README workflow infographic.
Input image 1 is the exact edit target: existing workflow diagram. Input image 2 is the approved new LightDubber brand logo (LD monogram with waveform + green-to-mint gradient wordmark).
Change ONLY the top-left branding: replace the large plain "LightDubber" title and the vertical green decorative bar immediately to its left with the approved icon-and-wordmark lockup from image 2. Fit this lockup neatly in the existing upper-left header region above the subtitle, with the LD symbol to the left of the gradient "LightDubber" wordmark. Keep the exact text "LightDubber" once in the header, with its gradient colors and icon shape matching image 2. Preserve the subtitle "Video translation, from speech to screen" in place. Keep every other part of image 1 unchanged: dimensions, off-white background, all five numbered stages, all existing English text, all icons, arrows, LightLLM and LightX2V services, background-audio bypass and footer. Do not add any labels or alter the workflow. Crisp legible typography, no clipping, no watermark.
assets.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: polished GitHub README architecture / workflow illustration for LightDubber. Create a precise, beautiful, legible technical infographic, landscape about 2:1, generous yet efficient whitespace, warm off-white background #f6f6f0, forest green #234c41, dark ink #162c2f, pale mint #c4e8d6. Flat vector-like finish, fine connectors, tasteful rounded panels, a premium open-source research-project aesthetic. Not a screenshot, not a dashboard, no photos, no neon, no tiny text, no watermark.
Header: left aligned LD monogram with waveform beside the green-to-mint gradient wordmark "LightDubber" and below it "Video translation, from speech to screen". Small top-right text "HIGH-LEVEL WORKFLOW".
Main layout: a single horizontal row of FIVE equally sized numbered cards, clear arrows only from left to right. Exactly these titles and short secondary labels:
01 "Understand" / "Words, timing, speakers" / "ASR + Alignment"
02 "Separate" / "Dialogue + background" / "Audio Separation"
03 "Translate & voice" / "Target-language speech" / "TTS"
04 "Lip-sync" / "Speaker-bound mouth edits"
05 "Compose" / "Paste back, mix, retime"
Add one restrained line icon per card: waveform with timing marks, split waveform, two speech bubbles, face outline with mouth, video timeline. Number badges clear.
Above the first card place a small video-frame icon and the label "Source video", connected DOWN to 01. Above the last card place a matching video-frame icon and the label "Dubbed video", connected UP from 05. No invented faces or sample data needed.
Below card 03, a separate outlined service pill reading "LightLLM" with secondary line "LLM". Connect ONLY this pill to card 03 with a short dashed two-way arrow. Below card 04 a matching service pill "LightX2V" with secondary line "Lip-sync Model", connected ONLY to 04 by short dashed two-way arrow. Add small legend "Dashed links: independent model services".
Draw one thin MINT background-audio bypass line from card 02, running below the service-pill area, ending in an upward arrow into card 05. Label this line clearly "Original background audio"; it must NOT feed the translation or lip-sync service boxes.
Bottom left a modest note "CLI + Web UI", bottom right "Speaker-aware • Modular • Self-hosted".
All text exact, correct English, readable at README display width. Make typography polished, uniform and not crowded. Logical connections are more important than decoration.
assets.layout_edit_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: existing LightDubber README workflow infographic.
Edit ONLY the top-left LD icon + LightDubber gradient wordmark lockup. It is currently crowded against the top edge and subtitle. Scale that whole logo lockup down uniformly to about 65% of its current width and height, preserving its icon, typography, spelling and green-to-mint gradient. Position the smaller lockup with its left edge aligned to the subtitle's left edge, around x=80 pixels on this 1754-pixel-wide image, top around y=25 pixels; keep its bottom above y=75 pixels, so there is a clear gap before the subtitle. Fill the cleared area seamlessly with the existing off-white background. Preserve the subtitle "Video translation, from speech to screen" in its EXACT current position, size and wording. Preserve all other image content and dimensions exactly: top-right heading, five stages, cards, icons, all English labels, service pills, arrows, background-audio route and footer. Do not enlarge or move the rest of the diagram, no other changes.
